# Comment Content

> Displays the contents of a comment.

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/comment-content`
**Category:** theme
**API Version:** 3
**Block Type:** Dynamic (server-rendered)

> Displays the contents of a comment.

## Block Relationships

**Ancestor blocks:**
- `core/comment-template`

## Attributes

_This block has no custom attributes._

## Supports

- **anchor**: `true`
- **color**:
  - gradients: `true`
  - link: `true`
- **typography**:
  - fontSize: `true`
  - lineHeight: `true`
  - textAlign: `true`
- **spacing**:
  - padding: `["horizontal","vertical"]`
- **html**: `false`

## Context

**Uses context:**

- `commentId`

## Block Markup

This is a **dynamic block**. It is rendered on the server and does not save HTML in post content.

In post content, it is stored as a block comment:

```html
<!-- wp:comment-content /-->
```
